title: Purpsmp
body:
![CIv built on Purpsmp](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/07e86989e1062046eba95e73d860c8cb1bbd494e.png)This server is designed to be the closest thing to singleplayer Minecraft, but with a community.

All gamerules are voted on by players, and the world border expands as the player count grows, so the world develops with the community.

Everything works exactly like it does in vanilla Minecraft — TNT duping, attribute swaps, spawn rates, and other mechanics are completely untouched. If it works in singleplayer, it works here.

The goal is to keep the experience as true to vanilla as possible.

No cheating.

No /homes No /spawn No /tpa all loot is grinded for.

One of the only true Vanilla Minecraft servers out there. 

Beware Some of the Best Pvpers Play the Server, grind loot the real way and show why you're the best.

Or live far away and make an epic build.

This Server is meant for all Players, hope to see you on!

Join the Discord for daily server updates and to participate in community votes.

CUSTOM PLUGIN THAT ARE ONLY ON HERE LIKE /killrewards and Invis hider
